title: Tiffin Tracker Update
message: Simple 4-digit room numbers, real-time member visibility & locked device profiles!
releaseNotes: Simple 4-digit room numbers (e.g. 4821) for instant flat sharing
Instant real-time visibility: newly joined roommates appear immediately on all screens
Profiles are locked to each device so members cannot change or impersonate profiles
Seamless cloud ledger adoption when joining a room
